tasks.label: CMake Configure
tasks.command: if [ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] && ! grep -q "CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=$(pwd)" build/CMakeCache.txt; then echo 'Source path changed! Cleaning build directory...'; rm -rf build; fi; cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

windows.command: if (Test-Path build/CMakeCache.txt) { if (!(Select-String -Path build/CMakeCache.txt -SimpleMatch -Pattern "CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=$((Get-Location).Path.Replace('\', '/'))")) { Write-Host 'Source path changed! Cleaning build directory...'; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build } }; cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM=C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/ninja.exe -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/gcc.exe -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/g++.exe -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

tasks.label: Install Android APK & Grant Permissions
tasks.command: adb install -r platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell pm grant com.example.booktogame android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE && adb shell appops set --uid com.example.booktogame MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow

windows.command: adb install -r platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb shell pm grant com.example.booktogame android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE; adb shell appops set --uid com.example.booktogame MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow

tasks.detail: Install debug APK and automatically grant storage + all-files access permissions

tasks.label: Run Android App (with Permissions)
tasks.command: adb install -r platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell pm grant com.example.booktogame android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE && adb shell appops set --uid com.example.booktogame MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow && adb shell am start -n com.example.booktogame/org.libsdl.app.SDLActivity

windows.command: adb install -r platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb shell pm grant com.example.booktogame android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE; adb shell appops set --uid com.example.booktogame MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow; adb shell am start -n com.example.booktogame/org.libsdl.app.SDLActivity

tasks.detail: Build APK, install it, grant all storage permissions, and start the app on device/emulator

tasks.label: Build Linux (Release)
tasks.command: if [ -f build_linux/CMakeCache.txt ] && ! grep -q "CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=$(pwd)" build_linux/CMakeCache.txt; then echo 'Source path changed! Cleaning build directory...'; rm -rf build_linux; fi; cmake -B build_linux -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build_linux && (chmod +x build_linux/BOOK_TO_GAME build_linux/PuterBridge build_linux/NativeWebViewWrapper 2>/dev/null || true)

windows.command: wsl bash -c 'cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && cmake -B build_linux -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build_linux && (chmod +x build_linux/BOOK_TO_GAME build_linux/PuterBridge build_linux/NativeWebViewWrapper 2>/dev/null || true)'

tasks.detail: Compile project for Linux (requires system SDL2 dependencies)

tasks.label: Build Run file for Linux
tasks.command: bash platforms/linux/pack_run.sh build_linux && cp build_linux/BookToGame.run . && chmod +x BookToGame.run && echo "" && echo "> BookToGame.run is ready. Launch it manually when needed." && echo ""
tasks.detail: Pack .run from build_linux without launching it
